title: Wright Brothers' First Flight
prompt: Describe the significance of the Wright brothers' first flight in 1903.
hint: Explain how their 12-second flight changed the future of transportation and aviation.
sample: The Wright brothers' first flight in 1903 lasted only 12 seconds, but it marked the beginning of modern aviation and changed how people travel forever.

ja.hint: 彼らの12秒間の飛行がどのように交通と航空の未来を変えたかを説明しましょう。
ja.sample: ライト兄弟の1903年の初飛行はわずか12秒でしたが、現代航空の始まりを告げ、人々の移動方法を永遠に変えました。

title: Wright Brothers' Engineering Journey
prompt: Explain how the Wright brothers' background in bicycle mechanics helped them design their first airplane.
hint: Discuss their curiosity, engineering skills, and years of testing gliders before creating the Wright Flyer.
sample: Before inventing the airplane, the Wright brothers owned a bicycle shop where they developed mechanical skills and curiosity that helped them design the Wright Flyer after years of testing.

ja.prompt: ライト兄弟が自転車の修理経験をどのように飛行機の設計に活かしたか説明してください。
ja.hint: 彼らの好奇心や技術力、そしてグライダーの長年の試験について話しましょう。
ja.sample: ライト兄弟は飛行機を発明する前に自転車店を経営し、そこで得た機械の知識と好奇心が、長年の試験を経てライトフライヤーの設計に役立ちました。

title: Impact of the Wright Flyer
prompt: Discuss the long-term impact of the Wright Flyer on global transportation and culture.
hint: Mention how aviation connected countries, families, businesses, and cultures worldwide.
sample: The Wright Flyer's success in 1903 laid the foundation for modern aviation, connecting people and cultures across the globe and transforming transportation forever.

title: Evolution of Flight Duration
prompt: Compare the duration of the Wright brothers' first flight with modern airplane flights.
hint: Note the 12-second first flight and how modern planes can fly for over 15 hours nonstop.
sample: The Wright brothers' first powered flight lasted only 12 seconds, while today, airplanes can stay in the air for more than 15 hours without stopping.
